name: mmmut
description: The MMMUT Notice Intelligence Platform is a robust system designed to digitize, index, and distribute college notices intelligently. Using state-of-the-art Optical Character Recognition (OCR) backed by AI, it automatically discovers notices from the university website, extracts text, categorizes them, and prepares them for distribution via WhatsApp.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "ADMIN,SCRAPER,OCR" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:scraper" "npm run dev:ocr"
